Visited Suresh Patil at Patil Instrumentation Services in Pune today, he's been a contractor for
us on and off for the last year, mainly doing installation work for our speed monitoring systems
in sugar mills. During the conversation Suresh brought up that he'd heard from someone at a trade
fair that Shree Distributors in Pune is trying to get into instrumentation distribution and might
reach out to us. He wasn't specific about who told him.

Suresh asked me to send him our updated contractor rate card, said no rush, maybe in a month is
fine.
